name: ILM Min Max Multiple Order Quantity for WooCommerce
author: ILM Tech

sections.description:
ILM Min/Max/Multiple Order Quantity for WooCommerce stops orders that are too small, too large or not in the right pack size. Free, with no licence key and no account.

🔗 Try it before you install

  • Live shop demo: add a product to the cart and try a quantity outside its limit.
  • Admin demo: set limits yourself (login demo / Ilm-Demo-2026, filled in for you). The demo runs the Pro add-on, so it shows the Free and the Pro features.
  • Step-by-step video guides and documentation.
  • Get the Pro add-on for category, role and customer rules, amounts, durations and conditions.

✨ Key features

  • Minimum Quantity – customers must order at least this many units of a product.
  • Maximum Quantity – customers cannot order more than this many units of a product.
  • Multiples of Quantity – customers order in packs, e.g. 3, 6, 9.
  • Per variation – give a variation its own numbers, or let customers mix variations to reach the product’s limit.
  • Shop-wide default – one Global value for every product without its own rule.
  • Rule table – edit the limits of all products and variations on one screen, with search, category filter and auto save.
  • Messages – change every message customers see, in every language of WPML or Polylang.

Limits are enforced everywhere a quantity can change:

  • the product page quantity box (minimum, maximum and step),
  • add to cart (classic, AJAX and the Store API used by blocks),
  • quantity changes in the cart,
  • the cart page and the checkout, classic and block – an order that breaks a limit is refused.

⭐ Free and Pro

This free plugin is complete for per-product and per-variation limits. The separate ILM Min/Max/Multiple Order Qty/Amt Pro add-on adds:

  • More rule types: category, brand, tag, user role, single customer and global rules, with a priority order.
  • Amounts: minimum and maximum order amount.
  • Allowed quantities: only listed quantities, e.g. 6, 12, 24.
  • Duration rules: limits per order, per period or for a customer’s lifetime.
  • Conditions, rule templates, CSV import/export and a blocked attempts log.
  • AI Assistant (separate AI add-on): creates rules from plain words, checks rules for conflicts and writes or translates the messages.

Get Pro or try it in the demo.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → ILM Min/Max, or edit a product and open Inventory → ILM Min/Max.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. The limits are given to the Store API, so the block quantity selectors respect them, and the block checkout refuses an order that breaks a limit.

What happens with a variable product?

The product’s numbers count all its variations together, so a customer can mix sizes to reach the minimum. Give a variation its own numbers to check it on its own (Configuration → Attributes).

Does it delete my data when I uninstall?

Deleting the plugin removes its rules table and settings.

short_description: Set a minimum, maximum and multiple (pack) order quantity per product and per variation. Checked in the classic and the block cart and checkout.

Cart: a quantity above the maximum is refused with a clear message.
Variable product: each size has its own minimum and maximum.
